def _load_json(self, protocol_source: ProtocolSource) -> None:
    # The I/O and compute-bound parsing will be handled asynchronously.
    protocol = await self._json_file_reader.read_async(protocol_source)
    commands = await self._json_translator.translate_commands_async(protocol)

    liquids = await self._json_translator.translate_liquids_async(protocol)
    for liquid in liquids:
        self._protocol_engine.add_liquid(
            id=liquid.id,
            name=liquid.displayName,
            description=liquid.description,
            color=liquid.displayColor,
        )

    for command in commands:
        self._protocol_engine.add_command(request=command)
    self._task_queue.set_run_func(func=self._protocol_engine.wait_until_complete)
